d: Pradhanmantri narendr modi ne chhattisgarh ke bastar men suraksha balon ke javanon ke sath dipavli manaee. is dauran unhonne naksal mukt bharat ke nirman men javanon ke yogdan ki sarahna karte hue unke sahas aur samarpan ki prashansa ki. vahin, raksha mantri rajnath sinh ne sikkim ke nathula men tainat javanon ke bich pahunchkar unke sath dipavli manaee aur unka utsah barhaya. idhar, jharkhand men bhi dipotsav ka umang aur ullas dekhne ko mil raha hai. rajyabhar men bajaron men raunak hai aur man kali ke darbar ko aakarshak dhang se sajaya gaya hai. vibhinn puja pandalon men shraddhaluon…
